description: This Java class 'RestExceptionHandler' provides global exception handling for REST controllers in a Spring Boot application. It defines handlers for specific exceptions like ResourceNotFoundException, MethodArgumentNotValidException, and a generic Exception handler, all of which construct and return structured HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and error details.

classes.name: RestExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice that globally handles exceptions thrown by REST controllers, providing custom JSON error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles ResourceNotFoundException, returning a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions, returning a 400 Bad Request response with validation error message.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error response.
